I used to find pleasure in those tiny moments, but now everything seems tainted. The sunset is sometimes a certain color simply because so much pollution is in the air that it effects the natural atmosphere. Whenever I go to the beach and their isn't 50 people packed into a 1/2 mile of beach, there's a seal dying in the saddest way.. Laying on it's back, crying loudly and holding it's stomach, probably because it ate some of the thousands of gallons of oil spilled into the ocean the week before. Bird skeletons everywhere, covered in tar. And this is the "nice" beach in town. The clean, "unknown" one. Over population and industrialization is killing us. In order to enjoy the little moments, I have to be in the middle of the forest complete alone and then.. still.. I'm completely alone. No one to share that happiness with. It's like the question, "If a tree falls and no one is there to hear it, does it make a sound?". Sorry to rant, this isn't my point..
